title: add_image_placeholder
description:
Insert an image placeholder in a passage and return the expected file path and filename the author must drop. Emits an + fallback
per R3 and refreshes the story's shared stylesheet so missing files render as labeled dashed-border boxes.

label.description: Kebab-case. Becomes the filename stem. Unique across all placeholders in the story.

extension.description: The extension the emitted will request. Author may later drop any of the allowed extensions at play time; if the declared one is missing, the fallback renders.

insertion_index.description: Character offset in passage text; null = append.

expected_path.description: Project-relative path if the story has been saved (e.g. 'assets/locked-door/ancient-tree.png'); otherwise annotated as pending a save location.

path_is_final.description: True once the story has been saved; false before first save (final path depends on save location).

clarification_triggers: label collides with an existing placeholder: ask pick_new_label | confirm_auto_suffix | cancel (no silent rename)
passage_name does not exist: ask to create it or cancel
acceptance_test_hooks: US3 scenario 1: add 'ancient-tree' to 'Forest' in story 'Locked Door' → returns assets/locked-door/ancient-tree.png
US3 scenario 2: after drop, played HTML loads the image inline
US3 scenario 3: without drop, played HTML shows labeled fallback
